headline: Deadlocked's PAL version gains matched functions as 18 pull requests land together
summary:
Lynder063 merged 18 pull requests of matching work for the PAL (European) release within about five minutes. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The largest are #54 with 30 functions, #75 with 22 and #72 with 17, and most of the rest come from Sumaiter in small groups of related helpers.

More is waiting: several pull requests opened during the day have not merged, the largest being #78 with 53 functions.
highlights: #75 matches 22 game functions (1,056 bytes), including table reads, flag updates and state changes.
#72 matches 17 variants of a fixed-size hash table lookup (1,952 bytes).
Smaller groups include drawing wrappers (#57), 2D point transforms (#60), smoothing routines (#61) and interpolation helpers (#62).
Issue #73 shares findings from an inspection using PS2Recomp, including 5 matching functions (128 bytes), and #74 lands five functions totalling the same 128 bytes.
#56 lets contributors read a disc image from any path, without copying it into the project.
Still open: #78 (53 functions), #55 (21), #77 (6), #79 (1) and draft #71, which has 45 functions for the NTSC-U release and still needs PAL mapping.
